name: One Take
tagline: Generates a polished product demo video from a URL by navigating the product and adding an AI voiceover.
problem: Developers spend weeks or money on demo videos, and good projects go unnoticed without them.
solution: A headless browser navigates the product, captures shots from a storyboard, and adds an AI voiceover and editing.
demo_moment: Team-described: paste a site URL and get a narrated demo video.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Solves a pain every hackathon team knows.

lessons: A tool for the judges' own pain point sells itself in the room.
